name: Port Vila
tagline: Blue holes, lagoons and a live volcano
summary: Port Vila is the easygoing capital of Vanuatu, on Efate island. Swim in the Blue Lagoon and Mele Cascades, see kastom villages, snorkel at Hideaway Island's underwater post office, eat at the Mamas' market, and fly to Tanna island to stand at the rim of Mount Yasur, one of the world's most accessible active volcanoes.
seasonNote: Dry season May to October; cyclone season November to April.
arrival: Flights from Brisbane, Sydney, Auckland and Fiji.
gettingAround: Minibuses (B on the plate) flagged anywhere; a rental for the island loop.
cashTip: Vanuatu uses the vatu; prices here are shown in US dollars. Carry vatu for markets and buses; tipping isn't customary.
foodTip: Lap lap, fresh coconut crab and Santo beef.
